canonical_project: PsiQuantum Moreton Bay Central utility-scale quantum computer facility
notes: PsiQuantum announced and then broke ground at Moreton Bay Central for a utility-scale fault-tolerant quantum computing facility. This is a specialised compute facility rather than a conventional colocation data centre; the company says it will house tens of thousands of photonic quantum chips, large cryogenic infrastructure, optical-fibre-networked cabinets, and phased future expansion.
